target.title: fix(cli): exit after model inspection output
target.body:
## Summary

- add a focused one-shot CLI exit helper for default-runtime inspection commands
- call it after successful `models list` and `models status` output paths
- preserve embedded/custom runtime callers so probes/tests keep controlling exits themselves
- drain stdout/stderr before forcing the default runtime exit

## What Problem This Solves

On a live OpenClaw 2026.5.4 install, non-interactive model inspection commands printed complete output but did not terminate. That makes scripts and SSH diagnostics hit their watchdog even though the requested data was already produced.

Observed before this fix on the installed package:

- `timeout 8s openclaw models list --json` printed output, then exited with rc 124
- `timeout 8s openclaw models status --json` printed output, then exited with rc 124
- active-handle debugging showed the route-first command path still had a spawned OpenClaw child/open stdin handle after output

## Scope / risk

- Scope is limited to successful `models list` / `models status` inspection output paths plus the shared one-shot exit helper.
- No changelog/release-owned files in the PR diff.
- Custom runtime/embedded callers are intentionally excluded from the forced-exit path.
- Vitest workers are excluded so unit tests do not terminate the test process.

## Current head

- Head: `aa1e57d6ee`
- GitHub mergeability after push: `MERGEABLE`; checks are recomputing on the refreshed head.
- PR diff vs current `main`: 4 files, 116 insertions.

## Evidence

Local verification after refreshing onto current `main`:

- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/cli/one-shot-exit.ts src/cli/one-shot-exit.test.ts src/commands/models/list.list-command.ts src/commands/models/list.status-command.ts`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint src/cli/one-shot-exit.ts src/cli/one-shot-exit.test.ts src/commands/models/list.list-command.ts src/commands/models/list.status-command.ts src/infra/gateway-boot-lifecycle.ts src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.ts`
- `corepack pnpm test src/cli/one-shot-exit.test.ts src/commands/models/list.status.test.ts` — 36 tests passed across 2 Vitest shards
- `corepack pnpm test test/scripts/package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts` — 41 tests passed; this covers the previously failing CI shard after refreshing onto latest `main`
- `corepack pnpm check:madge-import-cycles` — 0 cycles
- `corepack pnpm check:no-conflict-markers`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD -- src/cli/one-shot-exit.ts src/cli/one-shot-exit.test.ts src/commands/models/list.list-command.ts src/commands/models/list.status-command.ts`

Behavior evidence:

- The original live behavior proof reproduced model inspection commands that produced output but stayed alive until an external timeout killed them.
- The refreshed regression coverage verifies the helper does not force-exit in Vitest/custom-runtime contexts and drains output before invoking the default runtime exit.
